architecture_profile.ambiguity: After bounded intent lookup, prefer formalization if the architecture choice remains ambiguous. This preference does not prove a domain role.
architecture_profile.goal: Uniform, addressable, composable and observable domain rules for human and AI SDLC; preserve product behavior.
architecture_profile.intent_first: Inspect supplied intent, proposal and spec documents before guessing purpose from syntax. Record missing or conflicting context. Documents retain their declared authority.
architecture_profile.mechanics: Keep demonstrated parsing, representation, transport and adaptation mechanics procedural when they define no distinct domain rule.
architecture_profile.reuse: Reuse existing same-decision Specifications and their simple NOT/AND/OR compositions; no wrapper solely for a Boolean operator. An arbitrary Boolean fact is not automatically a Specification.
architecture_profile.tools: Formatting/linting responsibilities belong to formatter/linter rule sets. This responsibility does not prove an exact rule is configured or already enforced.

state.query: Find the rule that binds workspace identity, source ref, expected commit, allocation authority and declaration digest.

source.code:
WORKSPACE_ALLOCATION_SPEC: PredicateSpec[WorkspaceAllocationContext] = PredicateSpec(
    lambda context: (
        context.allocation["workspace_identity"] == context.requested_workspace_identity
        and context.allocation["source_ref"] == context.requested_source_ref
        and context.allocation["expected_commit"] == context.requested_expected_commit
        and context.allocation["identity_allocation_authorized"] is True
        and context.allocation["source_ref_initialization_authorized"] is True
        and context.allocation["declaration_sha256"] == context.requested_declaration_sha256
    ),
    name="subject_publication.workspace_allocation",
)
